summary.zh: 每人一位主导师，一位副导师。从选题开始做起，不套模板，不代做。通常做四个项目，其中至少一个必须失败过一次并重做。
summary.en: One lead mentor and one second reader per student. It starts at the choice of subject; there is no template and nothing is made on your behalf. Four projects is typical, and at least one of them has to have failed once and been rebuilt.

summary.zh: 一个题目，五周，全天在工作室。第一周只允许画图，第五周只允许做模型。中间三周随意。
summary.en: One brief, five weeks, all day in the studio. Drawing only in the first week, models only in the fifth. The three weeks between are yours.

summary.zh: 读一本书，看三十张图，说不超过一小时。免费，不点名，不发证书。
summary.en: One book, thirty images, no more than an hour of talking. Free, no register, no certificate.

summary.zh: 把你做到一半的东西挂满一面墙，三个人轮流问你为什么。结束后你会拿到一页纸的记录，仅此而已。
summary.en: Pin whatever you have so far across one wall and three people take turns asking why. You leave with a single page of notes and nothing more.
